checks.name: Page language is set
checks.rule: The page says its language, so a screen reader reads it in the right voice.

checks.name: Has a live text region
checks.rule: There is an aria-live (or status/log/alert) region for screen readers.

checks.name: Any key works
checks.rule: An ordinary key (J) makes the game respond: "any key is the switch".

checks.name: A click works
checks.rule: A click on the game makes it respond.

checks.name: A tap works
checks.rule: A tap on the game (the events a phone sends) makes it respond.

checks.name: Reads gamepads
checks.rule: The game asks the browser for gamepads while it runs.

checks.name: Ignores key repeat
checks.rule: Holding a key (repeat events) does no more than doing nothing.

checks.name: Leaves Tab alone
checks.rule: Tab is not taken over, so keyboard users can reach the controls.

checks.name: Speech is also written
checks.rule: Every spoken line also appears as text for screen readers and deaf players.

checks.name: Voice can be turned off
checks.rule: There is a control to turn the game’s own voice off, for screen-reader users.

checks.name: Sound is also shown
checks.rule: When the game plays sounds, it also shows text, so nothing is by sound alone.

checks.name: Asks about reduced motion
checks.rule: The game checks the player’s reduced-motion setting.

checks.name: Visible keyboard focus
checks.rule: The page styles keyboard focus so it can be seen.

checks.name: No game over
checks.rule: Playing badly for a minute never shows "game over" or counts lives.
